description: The City of Los Angeles publishes calculated stormwater capture by method. The schema lists seasonal rainfall in inches, total capture in acre-feet and cumulative contributions from spreading grounds, green infrastructure, streets and alleys, incidental capture, barrels and cisterns. These estimates can inform local water-supply and stormwater scenarios. The provider links its WaterCapture repository as the producing method. That repository describes assumed conversions from capture to water supply, including 100 percent for spreading grounds and 50 percent for selected green infrastructure. These are method assumptions, not verified recharge measurements. The dataset metadata reports its last data update in February 2020, and the repository was archived in January 2024. Current automated operation is not established. Coverage follows the provider-described Los Angeles facilities. Public catalogue pages and JSON metadata are free to access. The source specifies CC0 licensing. Data rows and export bodies were not fetched; distribution usability remains unverified. Related dashboard constants describe the calculation inputs.
